'## Pre-reads before Module N' does NOT inherit '## Prework's exemption per this rule's own 2026-08-23 narrowing, a narrowing this very file's maintainer block documents (line 113 raw) for the sibling M3-branch clause that WAS cut for exactly this shape: 'Module 3 draws that boundary for your own repo' (subject 'Module 3', verb 'draws'). The M4-branch line is structurally identical ('Module 4' subject, 'asks' verb) and was not addressed by that cut -- it lives in the mutually-exclusive no-module:earn-the-trust flag branch, easy to miss in a scan scoped to the visible/default branch. No maintainer accept-note in this file addresses this specific line (the adjacent Willison source-verification note discusses citation/stamp placement only, not this clause).
